summary: Added create-view/drop-view support for execute-write SQL. default_actions.py now registers `create-view` (cv, DatabaseResource) after create-table and `drop-view` (dv, TableResource) after drop-table. write_sql.py maps create+view to a create-view requirement on DatabaseResource (UnsupportedWriteSqlOperation when no database) and drop+view to drop-view on TableResource, placed before the alter/table case. sql_analysis.py renamed dropped_tables to dropped_tables_and_views and now includes drop+view keys, so SQLite's spurious delete on a dropped view is internal rather than a delete-row requirement. authentication.rst lists both new permissions for --root and documents the two actions with the required resource lines. `pytest -q tests/test_queries.py` passed: 90 passed.
concerns: docs/authentication.rst create-view section kept create-table's existing resource lines above the new section, so the resource block appears directly under the create-view heading as required.
The drop-view docs use `table` as the parameter name with description "the name of the view", matching the spec.
